distinguishing_features: An AC coil array around the transfer channel is intended to repel conductive non-ferrous contaminants within molten plastic.
The candidate places ferrous magnetic capture before a separate non-ferrous eddy-current stage.
The candidate proposes diverting the repelled particles into an offset collection chute.
parsed.objective_technical_problem: Remove ferrous and conductive non-ferrous contaminants from recycled plastic melt without relying on a screen that can clog.
parsed.viable_reason: Eddy-current separators act on exposed, mobile particles, whereas particles entrained in viscous melt cannot be deflected into a chute as claimed; the stated force estimate does not establish that the field can overcome melt drag.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: Using eddy currents to separate non-ferrous metal after ferrous magnetic capture is a familiar, routine separation approach, even though this proposed in-melt implementation is not viable.
